verdict.rationale: Filee states that nothing is uploaded and that it works offline, so private documents, photos and recordings never leave the computer. That local-only design means user data never reaches the vendor and cannot be used for model training. The probe also shows Filee is MIT open source, so the no-upload claim can be checked in the code. missing for 10: an explicit statement or policy on AI-training use of data, independent or hands-on verification that no network transmission occurs (including during engine downloads and updates).
